Messages.Author: Noal McDonald
Messages.Body:
Tim Eijpe <t_e...@my-deja.com> wrote:
> If I recall correctly. there will be a new downloadable rulebook
> after Sabbat Wars comes out.

Per earlier conversations with LSJ, the new rulebook won't have any new
rules implementations but it will have different wordings (notably agg
damage) to make the existing rules easier to understand.

> And the tourney Rules and Errata are downloadable
> at WW's site as far as i know.

As of 30 seconds ago...yes, they are.

Regards,
